description: This file defines a React component named TargetRoleDetailsPanel, which displays detailed information about a selected target role, including metadata, related skills, responsibilities, and assessment reports. It also includes utility functions for data normalization, extraction, and computation related to roles and personas.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string, converting unknown types safely.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input into a safe array of trimmed strings, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Transforms an array of strings into a list of properly punctuated sentences, removing prefixes.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Constrains a number within 0-100 and rounds to the nearest integer.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts and deduplicates skills from various nested fields within a persona object.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Converts a skill string into a lowercase trimmed key for comparison.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds common skills between persona skills and required skills, maintaining original casing.
